test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ​Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Their ages are in successive multiple of 3 from left to right end. B is second to the right of A. A is to the immediate left of E. Only three persons sit between C and F. The age of D is 18 years and the maximum. C sits to the left of E. What is the total age of A and B?

options.text:
18 years

×

duplicate options found. English Question 1 options 1,2

solution: **Persons : ** A, B, C, D, E and F 1) They are sitting in a row facing towards north. 2) B is second to the right of A and A is to the immediate left of E.
